$comment: Jane's Jeans brand theme as bootstrap-styled --bs-* custom properties (GFP RC1 Part 4 · B8). This is the vocabulary the Part-3 store ACTUALLY renders from (bootstrap-styled emits these on :root; @sorb/leaf overrides them inline during a preview). Mirrors the denim values in src/sorbBsTheme.js so the committed/loadable token set the bridge serves matches what the store consumes — a plugin 'load committed → edit → preview' now re-skins the store. The old color-*/button-*/radius-* sets (primitive/semantic/component.json) remain for the Storybook stories that still read them; this file is additive. No $version: these are a brand overlay, not a versioned tier, and omitting it keeps semantic.json's $version out of collision.

font-sans-serif.$value: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
